text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No. I'm just looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think I've changed at all since the old days.
I'm still just an Umamusume who runs for herself,
guided purely by what she loves."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Yet there were all of you, sharing in that dream,
calling out to me, and supporting me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It makes me realize that "Ines Fujin"
is truly right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice to meetcha~!
I'm gonna run as selfishly as I want.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So keep your eyes on me.
And dream with me."
